churn_resistance.rationale: Strong boundaries and centralized config mean a framework upgrade touches only app.config.ts and package.json, and swapping the API means editing one service. Docked for the duplicated title logic, the duplicated type definition, and the heavy resolver re-run on a query-param change.

findings.issue: provideHttpClient(withFetch()) uses withFetch, deprecated in Angular v22 because FetchBackend is now the default HttpBackend
findings.suggestion: Call provideHttpClient() with no features (or drop it entirely, since HttpClient is injectable by default in v21+)

findings.issue: @angular/forms is a declared dependency but nothing in src/ imports FormsModule/ReactiveFormsModule
AngularNodeAppEngine({ allowedHosts: ['*'] }) disables host validation; current SSR guidance says keep an explicit list unless a trusted proxy validates forwarded headers
findings.suggestion: Configure an explicit allowlist (localhost + deployment host) or document the trusted-proxy assumption and enable trustProxyHeaders deliberately

findings.issue: Document-title logic is duplicated as an effect in four components while two routes use route.title, so a title-format change ripples across files
findings.suggestion: Register a custom TitleStrategy (e.g. '<h1> – Pokédex') and set the h1 text once per route via route data

findings.issue: runGuardsAndResolvers: 'paramsOrQueryParamsChange' re-runs the entire pokemon resolver (species, evolution chain, all version groups and move resources) whenever the ?game query param changes, though the tables are pure derivations of already-fetched data
findings.suggestion: Bind the game query param as a component input and derive the tables with computed/linkedSignal, or split the resolver so only the table selection depends on the query param

findings.issue: withEventReplay() and the explicit ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush on every component (e.g. app/src/app/app.ts:9) are v21-era boilerplate that v22 enables by default; the v22 CLI schematic no longer generates them
findings.suggestion: Use a bare provideClientHydration() and drop changeDetection: OnPush from component decorators

findings.issue: Default port 4000 (CLI scaffold default) while the spec says PORT defaults to 3000, plus leftover scaffold comments (example REST API block at line 18, PM2 check at line 56)
findings.suggestion: Default to Number(process.env['PORT'] ?? 3000) and delete the unused scaffold comments

findings.issue: Controls are rendered readonly/disabled until afterNextRender, fighting v22's default event replay and leaving SSR visitors unable to interact before hydration
findings.suggestion: Remove the ready signal and rely on event replay, which exists precisely to handle pre-hydration interaction

findings.issue: vitest, jsdom, tsconfig.spec.json and the ng test target scaffold a unit-test setup with zero test files
findings.suggestion: Either add tests for the pure logic (util.ts, catalog mapping, move-table sorting) or remove the scaffolding

findings.issue: Two distinct interfaces named TypeResource exist (page-data.ts and catalog.service.ts:28), inviting import confusion as the files grow
findings.suggestion: Rename one (e.g. TypeDetailResource) or share a single definition in a models module

summary: A genuinely current Angular 22 app: signals everywhere, declarative server routes, resolver-to-input data loading, typed API boundaries and a lean, zoneless dependency set — a framework upgrade would touch almost nothing. The notable forward-looking blemishes are one deprecated call (withFetch), two redundant v21-era idioms (withEventReplay, explicit OnPush), an unused @angular/forms dependency, and copy-pasted title logic. Copy-pasted CLI scaffold in server.ts and the wildcard allowedHosts are small but should be cleaned up before this becomes a long-lived codebase.

apis.replacement: provideHttpClient() — FetchBackend is the default HttpBackend since v22 (angular.dev/api/common/http/withFetch)
bare provideClientHydration() — incremental hydration and event replay are enabled by default in v22 (angular.dev/api/platform-browser/withIncrementalHydration; angular-cli#32996)
explicitly set but redundant: OnPush is the default strategy since v22 (angular.dev/api/core/ChangeDetectionStrategy)
